# V. BOX PARTICLE FILTER IMPLEMENTATION 

Due to the large uncertainty in the measurements, the posterior pdf could be characterized by an extensive support. Consequently, the number of (point) particles required to cover this significant portion of the state space, can be also very large. One natural solution to reduce the number of particles is to use non-point particles, such as the multidimensional rectangular or box particles [14].
